title: Good hosts look after *the house.*
intro: We work to the Travelife criteria for tour operators and travel agents, with a trained sustainability coordinator on our team — and we ask every partner to share these standards.

recognition.badgeLabel: Travelife Partner: check our entry in the public Travelife register
recognition.statement: **Travelife Partner** — independently assessed against the Travelife Partner criteria for tour operators and travel agents (recognised since November 2025).
recognition.explain: Partner is the first of Travelife’s two recognition levels: an independent assessment of how we manage sustainability against about 60 mandatory criteria, renewed every two years.
recognition.register: Check us in the public Travelife register

figures.title: Less energy, *far less gas.*
figures.period: January–October 2025, compared with the same months of 2024.

items.label: Energy use
items.text: Lights and equipment are switched off after hours and whenever a room is not in use.

items.label: Gas use
items.text: Same ten months, same office: down by more than a third.

quote.photoAlt: A village of stone Svan towers among green fields and trees, with forested slopes and a snow-capped range behind it, in Svaneti, Georgia.
quote.photoCaption: Svan towers below the Greater Caucasus, Svaneti

items.title: Business travel, offset
items.text: We offset the carbon footprint of all our international business travel.

items.title: Public transport and remote days
items.text: We reimburse every employee’s yearly public-transport pass. Everyone works from home one day a week, and a second day when the office isn’t needed.

items.title: Accommodation and restaurants: certificates first
items.text: We prefer accommodation and restaurants with acknowledged sustainability certificates. Our target for 2026: at least half of our accommodation with sustainability credentials.

items.title: No excursions that do harm
items.text: No excursions that harm people, animals or nature, and none involving the trade, consumption, close contact or performances of animals.

items.title: Zero tolerance on child exploitation
items.text: Zero tolerance for child exploitation, forced labour and human trafficking — in our own work and in every partnership.
